info.description: HTTP API for Vohu's multi-user platform — users, roles, polymorphic resource access, SSH connections, conversations/chat, provider keys, custom models, and the agent tool catalog. Every endpoint responds through shared.BaseResponse (see internal/platform/shared/response.go) — {result, success, resultCode, validationErrors, error} — regardless of success or failure.
info.title: Vohu Platform API

get.description: Lists every public tool plus any private tool the caller holds at least "read" access to. Every tool in this catalog is SSH-connection-bound — its Go implementation always takes a connectionId argument and checks the caller's access to that specific connection separately, on every call.
Returns one catalog entry by ID. Requires at least "read" access to this specific tool.

put.description: Changes a tool between public (available to everyone) and private (only whoever's been granted access). This is the only field the catalog lets an admin change — name/description/implemented are facts about the underlying Go implementation, not data this API owns. Requires "manage" access to this specific tool.

post.description: Exchanges a username and password for an access/refresh token pair. No auth required — this is the entry point that produces tokens.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair. No auth header required — the refresh token in the body is the credential.

get.description: Lists every command rule for one SSH connection. The caller must hold "manage" on that connection.
get.summary: List an SSH connection's command rules

403.description: Caller doesn't hold manage on the target connection

post.description: Adds one allow/deny rule to an SSH connection's command policy. Rules are first-match-wins within a connection (evaluated in creation order) — a connection with no rules permits nothing. The caller must already hold "manage" on the target connection, same level required to delete it.

403.description: Caller doesn't hold manage on the target connection

put.description: Changes a rule's program/argsPrefixes/allowed. The caller must hold "manage" on the connection this rule belongs to.

403.description: Caller doesn't hold manage on the connection this rule belongs to

delete.description: Removes one rule from an SSH connection's command policy. The caller must hold "manage" on the connection this rule belongs to.

403.description: Caller doesn't hold manage on the connection this rule belongs to

get.description: Lists the caller's own conversations. There's no separate access-policy gate here beyond being authenticated — conversations are scoped to their owner by construction.

post.description: Starts a new conversation — provider and model are fixed for its whole lifetime once created. customModelId, if set, names one of the caller's (or a global) custom model presets to use instead of the account's single per-provider key.

get.description: Returns one page of a conversation's messages, newest first (page 1 is the most recent; higher page numbers reach further into the past) — for scroll-up-to-load-older-history. 404s for a conversation the caller doesn't own.

post.description: Sends a message and streams the reply as a Server-Sent Events response (Content-Type: text/event-stream) — this is NOT a plain JSON endpoint despite the shared.BaseResponse envelope every other route uses; it's documented here for completeness but tools like "Try it out" won't render it usefully. Events, in order: zero or more "chunk" (data is a raw string — one piece of assistant text as it streams in), then either "done" (data is []MessageResponse — every message this turn produced: the assistant's reply and any tool call/result pairs, already persisted) or "error" (data is a plain error string; nothing was persisted).

200.description: SSE stream — see description for event shapes

get.description: Lists every account-wide custom model preset (never the API key values). Requires wildcard "manage" access on resource type "custom_model".

post.description: Adds a named OpenAI-compatible preset every user can pick when starting a new chat, not just the creator. The key is encrypted at rest and never returned by any response. Requires wildcard "manage" access on resource type "custom_model".
post.summary: Create a global custom model preset

get.description: Lists every custom model preset the caller can pick when starting a new chat — their own presets plus every global one — regardless of whether they're allowed to manage global presets. Deliberately not gated by "manage" access, unlike the other routes in this module.
get.summary: List custom models available to me

get.description: Lists the caller's own named OpenAI-compatible presets (never the API key values).

post.description: Adds a named OpenAI-compatible preset (URL + key + model) owned by the caller — unlike provider-keys' single "openai" slot, any number of these can coexist (a local Ollama server and a DeepSeek account at once, say). The key is encrypted at rest and never returned by any response.

delete.description: Deletes one of the caller's own custom model presets by ID.
Deletes an account-wide custom model preset by ID. Requires wildcard "manage" access on resource type "custom_model".
delete.summary: Delete a global custom model preset

get.description: Returns the caller's own complete access profile — every resource-access grant that's personally theirs (direct or via a role they hold), plus the best level they hold on each known resource type at large. The frontend uses this right after login to decide what nav items and buttons to show; it's a UX layer, every endpoint still enforces its own access independently regardless of what this reports.
Lists every account-wide default provider key (never the key value itself). Requires wildcard "manage" access on resource type "provider_key".

post.description: Sets (or replaces) the account-wide default API key for a provider — used for any user who hasn't set their own personal key. The key is encrypted at rest and never returned by any response. Requires wildcard "manage" access on resource type "provider_key".

get.description: Lists the caller's own personal provider keys (never the key values themselves).

post.description: Sets (or replaces) the caller's own personal API key for a provider — always takes priority over the global default for that caller's own chats. The key is encrypted at rest and never returned by any response.

delete.description: Removes the caller's own personal key for a provider. Their chats fall back to the global default, if any.
Removes the account-wide default key for a provider. Chats using it fall back to any other configured key. Requires wildcard "manage" access on resource type "provider_key".

get.description: Lists every resource-access grant in the system. Requires wildcard "read" access on resource type "resource_access".

post.description: Grants (or upserts, if one already exists for the same grantee+resource) a resource-access row. The caller must already hold "manage" on the target resource — granting access to X requires manage on X, no separate meta-permission.

403.description: Caller doesn't hold manage on the target resource

delete.description: Deletes one resource-access grant by its own ID. The caller must hold "manage" on the resource that grant refers to.

get.description: Lists every role. Requires wildcard "read" access on resource type "role".

post.description: Creates a new role. Requires wildcard "write" access on resource type "role".

409.description: A role with this name already exists

get.description: Returns one role by ID. Requires at least "read" access to this specific role.

put.description: Renames a role. Requires "write" access to this specific role.

delete.description: Deletes a role. Requires "manage" access to this specific role. Users holding the role are not deleted, just lose whatever the role granted them.

get.description: Lists SSH connections the caller holds at least "read" access to — every connection, if the caller holds a wildcard "read"/"manage" grant on resource type "ssh_connection".

post.description: Registers a new SSH connection. Private-key auth only — the connection is test-dialed (real handshake, no command run) before it's saved, so a bad host or mismatched key fails loudly here instead of the first time the agent tries to use it. The key is encrypted at rest and never returned by any response. The creator is auto-granted "manage" on the new connection. Requires wildcard "write" access on resource type "ssh_connection".

400.description: Validation error, or the connection test failed (bad host/key)

get.description: Returns one SSH connection by ID (never the private key). Requires at least "read" access to this specific connection.

put.description: Changes an SSH connection's fields. Omitting privateKey keeps the existing key (there's no way to show it back to the client to prefill a form). Requires "write" access to this specific connection.

delete.description: Deletes an SSH connection. Requires "manage" access to this specific connection.

get.description: Lists users the caller holds at least "read" access to — every user, if the caller holds a wildcard "read"/"manage" grant on resource type "user". filter is a JSON-encoded shared.DynamicFilter.

post.description: Creates a new user account. Requires wildcard "write" access on resource type "user".

get.description: Returns one user by ID. Requires at least "read" access to this specific user (a direct grant, a wildcard grant, or a grant on a role this user holds).

404.description: Not found, or not permitted (existence isn't leaked to a caller with no access)

put.description: Changes a user's email and/or enabled flag. Requires "write" access to this specific user.

delete.description: Deletes a user account. Requires "manage" access to this specific user.

post.description: Grants a user every resource access attached to the given role. Requires "manage" access to the target user.
post.summary: Assign a role to a user

customModelId.description:
CustomModelID, when set, names one of the caller's (or a global)
custommodel.CustomModel presets to use for this conversation's
credentials instead of the single per-user/global "openai" key —
see Conversation.CustomModelID. Not validated here (conversation
never imports custommodel); chat.buildLLM resolves and checks
ownership lazily the first time the conversation is actually used.

allowed.description:
Allowed defaults to true (an allow rule) when omitted — the common
case, since this is an allow-list policy; a caller has to opt in
explicitly to write a deny rule (e.g. carving an exception out of a
broader allow rule that matches first).

argsPrefixes.description:
ArgsPrefixes: omitted (nil) means "don't change"; an explicit empty
array clears it (the rule then matches the program regardless of
args). encoding/json already distinguishes the two on its own — an
omitted key decodes to nil, "[]" decodes to a non-nil empty slice.

privateKey.description:
PrivateKey is optional on update — omitted means "keep the existing
key," since there is no way to show it back to the client to
prefill a form.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the access token from POST /auth/login or /auth/refresh.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
